description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods with respect to temperature. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 63.7 at an x-value of 0.1, rises to 69.9 at 0.2, fluctuates to reach a plateau of 71.7 between 0.5 and 0.6, drops to a local minimum of 67.2 at 0.7, peaks at 75.2 at 0.8, and ends at 73.5 at 1.0. The "LUFFY" method is shown as a solid dark red line with star markers, beginning at 76.1 at 0.1, peaking initially at 78.8 at 0.2, remaining steady at 76.1 between 0.3 and 0.4, and climbing to reach its highest peaks of 80.6 at both 0.8 and 1.0, with a slight dip to 78.8 at 0.9. The "SFT" method is depicted by a solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, starting at 76.1 at 0.1, declining to a sharp low of 69.9 at 0.5, recovering to 76.1 at 0.6, and fluctuating before concluding at 74.3 at the final x-value of 1.0.
